items.title: How Investors May Respond To Amgen (AMGN) Earnings Beat
items.summary: Amgen reported strong Q3 2026 results, with revenue of US$10.37b, GAAP net income of US$3.86b, and raised full year guidance to US$38.9b to US$39.7b of revenue and GAAP EPS of US$18.34 to US$19.28. Positive Phase 3 data for IMDELLTRA, TEZSPIRE and dazodalibep underline Amgen's push into oncology and autoimmune indications, which had already been central to its longer term growth story.
